name: Sleet-Cryonis
description: Sleet-Cryonis is a small ice world where temperatures plunge so low that even the atmosphere threatens to freeze. Sleet of nitrogen and methane ice falls from the thin sky in slow, drifting curtains that accumulate in brittle layers across the surface. The landscape is a desolation of shattered moraine, fields of ice boulders broken and re-broken by thermal expansion cycles over millions of years. Lakes of liquid methane pool in the deeper craters, their surfaces occasionally freezing over before thawing again in the marginally warmer daylight.

The world is beautiful in its desolation, with the methane lakes reflecting the stars in mirror-perfect surfaces when calm and the crystal caverns beneath the ice glittering with frost formations of exquisite delicacy. The sleet falls with an almost musical quality in the low gravity, each crystal tinkling against the surface like a tiny bell. But the beauty is lethal, a moment's exposure to the atmosphere would freeze human tissue solid in seconds.

An abandoned mining complex sits near the largest methane lake, its equipment frozen in place and its corridors open to the vacuum-thin atmosphere. The complex was established to extract water ice for fuel processing but was abandoned when the operation proved unprofitable at such extreme temperatures. More recently, smugglers have used the empty complex as a cache, stashing contraband in the frozen corridors where the cold preserves everything indefinitely.

Sleet-Cryonis occupies an odd niche as a world with no inherent value that has acquired significance through its very worthlessness. The abandoned mine provides shelter, the cold preserves cargo without power requirements, and the remote location keeps traffic minimal. Law enforcement considers the planet too low-priority to patrol regularly, making it a reliable if uncomfortable dead drop for those operating outside legal boundaries.
